name: Layla
description: Canadian mental health care company offering online and in-person therapy and psychological assessments.
notes: DMZ alumni. HQ Toronto per directories (80 Atlantic Ave and 1187A King St W conflicting, so address not set). Site says supporting clients since 2019.

name: League
description: Toronto digital health platform company offering AI agents and a digital front door for health plans and providers.
notes: HQ Toronto per Globe and Mail and Goodmans. Series C date not confirmed. About USD 225M raised in total per Globe and Mail.

name: Learn Formula
description: Online platform of courses and webinars for continuing professional development of regulated professionals.
notes: Site live. Markham HQ comes from the DMZ listing only and could not be independently confirmed (the markham subdomain is a City of Markham staff training portal).

name: Legio
description: AI-native safety and security operations software for college and university campus safety teams.
notes: Toronto-based per BetaKit; founded April 2026; seed led by Klass Capital. Founders Darren Hill (CEO), Mike Wertman (CTO), Joe Crampton (CPO).

name: Let's
description: Tool letting skilled influencers design, market, sell and manage themed group trips.
notes: DMZ cohort company. Website returned 404 and no independent coverage found, so status and HQ not independently confirmed.

name: LifeTales
description: Memoir app for recording, transcribing and publishing life stories as books for descendants.
notes: DMZ alumni. Site live (public beta, footer copyright 2019-24). Toronto HQ from DMZ listing only, not independently confirmed.

name: Lighthouse
description: AI-powered applicant tracking software that screens, scores and engages candidates.
notes: Lighthouse Hiring Innovations. Toronto per PitchBook (listed address is the DMZ office, so no pin address). DMZ Ventures listed as investor.

name: Lightster
description: Platform connecting product teams with a pool of qualified users for surveys, interviews and user testing.
notes: DMZ alumni. Toronto and seed stage per CB Insights (listed address is the DMZ office, not used).

name: LiveGauge
description: Analytics platform measuring audience traffic, leads and sentiment at events, in retail and out-of-home settings.
notes: DMZ alumni. Address from company site. Founding year 2013 appears only on Datanyze (not used).
address: 130 Queens Quay E, Suite 613, Toronto, ON M5A 0P6

name: Loombotic
description: Custom wire harness manufacturer with instant online quoting and about one-week delivery.
notes: YC Fall 2024. Toronto per YC; some roles also in Austin, TX; site copyright names Fabraicate, Inc. (US entity), so HQ not firmly confirmed.

name: LSK Technologies
description: Low-cost molecular diagnostic testing platform (a diagnostic lab in a box), now part of Nicoya.
notes: Acquired by Nicoya (site: 'LSK is now part of Nicoya'; date not given). YC Summer 2020.

name: LUS Brands
description: Curly hair care brand (Love Ur Curls) selling cleansers, conditioners and stylers.
notes: YC Winter 2018. lusbrands.com redirects to loveurcurls.com. Toronto per YC and press; Built In lists Mississauga (also GTA). No street address found.

name: Lyteflo
notes: HQ is Montreal, QC per company site (lyteflo.com); Toronto was only inferred from a press dateline.

name: ManagingLife
description: Digital chronic pain management app (Manage My Pain) and AI companion for pain psychology support.
notes: DMZ alumni. Toronto and founding year per company About page and Gust. No street address found.

name: Manifest Climate
description: AI-powered platform that assesses sustainability disclosures and documents against frameworks such as CSRD, ISSB and TCFD.
notes: Address from company site.
address: 33 Bloor St E, Suite 604, Toronto, ON M4W 3H1

name: Mash
description: AI assistant app acting as a personal CRM, note-taker and reminder tool for people and to-dos.
notes: Site now shows a personal AI assistant (earlier B2B knowledge-agent positioning; pivoted mid-2024 per Wellfound). Entity 12845393 Canada Inc. Toronto per VC Backed and Startup Seeker; seed June 2022 per VC Backed (day approximate). Careers page linked but not checked.

name: Mecka AI
description: Data and deployment layer for physical AI, capturing human activity data to train robots.
notes: Described as Toronto- and New York-based and domiciled in the US; about 40 of 45 staff are in Toronto (Analytics Insight), so kept as Toronto but HQ not firmly confirmed. Led by Sequoia, Nvidia also backed.

name: MedMe Health
description: Software for pharmacy clinical services including scheduling, documentation, billing and an AI scribe.
notes: YC Winter 2021. Merged with duplicate entry medmehealth.com. Address per CB Insights. About USD 3.7M raised per company profile; debt financing Aug 2025 per VC Backed (not verified).
address: 175 Bloor St E, Toronto, ON M4W 3R8

name: MedMe Health
notes: duplicate of name:medmehealth

name: MedStack
description: Compliance software for digital health companies (MedStack Control and Exos) supporting PIPEDA, HIPAA and SOC 2.
notes: DMZ alumni. Toronto per directories. PitchBook marks it as acquired/merged (operating subsidiary, 2024-11-01) but acquirer unconfirmed; site says operated by Launchit Solutions Inc. Seed round (undated here) led by Telus Ventures per BetaKit. Address sources conflict, not set.

name: Mero Technologies
description: Sensor and analytics platform that automatically logs and validates commercial cleaning.
notes: DMZ alumni. Address from company site.
address: 325 Front St W, Floor 2, Toronto, ON M5V 2Y1

name: Micruity
description: Data infrastructure for annuities and lifetime income products connecting insurers, recordkeepers and plan sponsors.
notes: DMZ alumni. Toronto HQ, founding year and address per CB Insights and Built In (not the company site).
address: 295 Adelaide St W, Unit 703, Toronto, ON M5V 0L4

name: Mixr
description: Team building through online game tournaments for remote teams.
notes: YC Summer 2021. YC lists the company as Inactive and the website is unreachable (TLS error). No formal shutdown announcement found.

name: MixRank
notes: HQ is San Francisco per company site (mixrank.com), not GTA.

name: Modem
description: Shared record of customer concerns that links feedback from support and sales to bugs and fixes for developers.
notes: Toronto-based per BetaKit; founder Ben Vinegar. Previously modem.dev (redirects to modem.ai). Site does not state location.
